answer: A grove audit at settlement checks every identity against the knoll registry, and any identities traced to one operator lose their saffron escrow entirely. The forfeited rewards are redistributed to honest peers, and all of the operator's pending attestations are revoked. A fake that would have earned roughly 258,000 POA loses its full reward, so an operator running five fakes forfeits about 1,290,000 POA before any of it can be withdrawn.
